question: Should this PR become the canonical Neuralwatt branch and establish combined subscription-kWh plus prepaid-balance semantics as the supported provider contract?
rationale: The two open branches implement overlapping provider integrations with different presentation histories, and only a repository owner can select the landing branch and permanent quota semantics.

options.title: Adopt this branch
options.body: Treat this mergeable, hardened branch as canonical after its three presentation defects are fixed and exact-head live proof is supplied.

options.title: Retain the original branch
options.body: Keep https://github.com/steipete/CodexBar/pull/1760 canonical and port this branch's subscription, parsing, account-refresh, and presentation hardening into it.

options.title: Pause the provider
options.body: Leave both branches unmerged until maintainers decide whether subscription and prepaid pools should be represented together in CodexBar.

recommendation.title: Adopt this branch
recommendation.body: Treat this mergeable, hardened branch as canonical after its three presentation defects are fixed and exact-head live proof is supplied.

likelyOwner.reason: They authored most of the provider hardening and branch reconciliation commits and are the strongest available owner for the presentation and canonical-branch decision.
